data_templates: What you carried today wasn’t yours alone.
You don’t need to hold this through the night.
Sleep will come. It always does.
The dark is not asking questions.
The night can carry this for you.
Your eyelids are heavier than your thoughts.
Your body remembers how to rest.
The mind can dim its lights.
Breath by breath, you disappear a little.
The night knows what to do.
